prompt: The app is getting really slow after about 30 minutes of use. The task list re-renders every time I hover over anything, and scrolling is janky. I have about 200 tasks. How do I debug this performance issue?

assertions.text: Suggests Vue render tracking tools (onRenderTracked/onRenderTriggered or devtools)
Identifies subscription or watcher leaks as potential cause of degradation over time
Recommends optimization techniques like shallowRef, v-memo, or virtual scrolling
